stop.0.blurb: Igama nendlela yokubuyela. Alukho ukubuzwa lapha ukuthi ufanelwe yivoti — ukuhlala endaweni yikho konke okudingekayo.
stop.0.title: Dala i-akhawunti yakho
stop.1.blurb: Khetha indawo noma iqhaza lomphakathi, bese uya emphakathini, emsebenzini, noma ekufundeni.
stop.1.title: Hlola umhlaba
stop.10.blurb: Imilayezo eqondile neyeqembu — imfihlo, njengephepha lokuvota.
stop.10.title: Imilayezo
stop.11.blurb: qoqa izigxiviso ukuze ubuze umbuzo kuwo wonke umuntu.
stop.11.title: Izicelo
stop.12.blurb: Lapho indawo ikhuluma khona yona — imilayezo ehambisana nemithethosivivinywa, ukuphikisana kwezikhalo nezicelo ezikhona ngempela.
stop.12.title: Amholo
stop.13.blurb: Isikwele esibheke indawo yegunya eyodwa: irekhodi elifanayo elivulekile, kodwa limayelana nalapha kuphela.
stop.13.title: Izindawo zomphakathi zendawo — isikwele
stop.14.blurb: Ubufakazi obungavalwa irekhodini eliphilayo — inkulumo eba ubufakazi.
stop.14.title: Izindawo zomphakathi zendawo — amholo
stop.15.title: Ukukhetho
stop.16.blurb: Isigaba sokuvuma — vuma ngasesikweni abantu obafuna babe semaphepheni okuvota.
stop.16.title: Iphepha lokuvota livulekile
stop.17.blurb: Hlela izinketho zakho — izihlalo zihဝanwa ngokulunga, futhi alikho ivoti elichithwa.
stop.17.title: Iphepha lokuvota elihlelwe
stop.18.blurb: Ukubala, isigaba ngesigaba — buka amavoti ehamba kuze kube yilapho zonke izihlalo zigcwele.
stop.18.title: Imiphumela
stop.19.blurb: Uma uhlala lapho, ungagijima — lokho kuphela okudingekayo.
stop.19.title: Funa isikhalo
stop.2.title: Ikhaya
stop.20.blurb: Amaphathi, amabhizinisi, izinhlangano ezingezonkukha — irejista eyodwa evulekile, ayikho imishini yamaphathi.
stop.20.title: Izinhlangano
stop.21.blurb: Yonke imbiqo iyirekhodi lomphakathi — amaphanele amajaji, amajuri abahlali.
stop.21.title: Uhlu lwezindaba zenkantolo
stop.22.blurb: Irekhodi lomphakathi eliphilayo — alikwazi ukulungiswa ngasese.
stop.22.title: Irekhodi lomphakathi
stop.23.blurb: Yonke isinqumo, ihambisana ne-hash — yiqinisekise wena.
stop.23.title: Ikhala lokucwaninga
stop.24.blurb: Umthethosisekelo ushintsha ngomnyango omabili kuphela — wonke ovulekile.
stop.24.title: Izilungiselelo
stop.25.blurb: Yonke isikhathi, usuku lokugcina, kanye nomngcele oqala inqubo ngaphandle kokuba kube nomuntu ocela.
stop.25.title: Izikhathi
stop.26.blurb: Iphutha, umbuzo, noma okuthile okudinga ukubuyekezwa — kufayilwe lapha.
stop.26.title: Bika inkinga
stop.27.blurb: Umngcele wezalo elibalulekile kanye nokusebenza kwezinyathelo eziyisikhombisa okwenza indawo iphile.
stop.27.title: Indlela indawo evuka ngayo
stop.28.blurb: Indlela izindawo zihlanganiswa ngayo zibe yinye — ngeningi elikhethekile elimbili, lapho ukuhlanganisa nokuhamba kukhophiwe.
stop.28.title: Ukubumbana kwenyunyana
stop.29.blurb: Abavoti bafola izinga elilodwa futhi baqhubeke nokuzibusa.
stop.29.title: Ukususa isigaba esiphakathi
stop.3.blurb: Impilo yakho yezomphakathi endaweni eyodwa — ukuhlala, amavoti akhiphwe (hhayi indlela avotiwe ngayo), kanye nezenzo zakho zomphakathi.
stop.3.title: Irekhodi lami
stop.30.blurb: Ukuhambela kokubuyisela, amaphuzu okusebenza, nokuvikela indawo ebuyiselwe.
stop.30.title: Ukwakha kabusha uhulumeni olulahlekile
stop.31.blurb: Umfelandawonye, imingcele exazululwe yiningi elikhethekile, nokuthi izimo zihlala kanjani njengomhlaba owodwa.
stop.31.title: Phakathi kohulumeni
stop.32.blurb: Isabelo esincane, esingenawo imingcele ngokubamba iqhaza — sikhokhelwa kubantu, hhayi kuma-akhawunti.
stop.32.title: Isisizelo sezomphakathi
stop.33.blurb: Yonke inkontileka inezimiso ezingezansi — vula eyodwa ukuze ubone izigxiviso zayo nesivumelwano.
stop.33.title: Izivumelwano
stop.34.blurb: Okokuqala kwezomphakathi, izinhambo eziqondiswe, kanye namaphuzu abalulekile endawo, okugcinwe irekhodini elingongezelelwa kuphela.
stop.34.title: Izimpumelelo
stop.35.blurb: Imali yakho, imakethe evulekile, kanye nezimali zomphakathi — wonke umnotho endaweni eyodwa.
stop.35.title: Imakethe
stop.36.blurb: Lokhu okubambile nokuhambile — kuyimfihlo yakho, njengephepha lokuvota.
stop.36.title: Iwallet yami
stop.37.blurb: Okunikezwayo nezicelo phakathi kwabantu — imakethe enamacala amabili, exazululwa obala.
stop.37.title: Imakethe evulekile
stop.38.blurb: Ukuthi iyini idyunithi nokuthi imali ikhipha kanjani — okungabonakali, ngaphandle kwemigqa yokukhokha.
stop.38.title: Idyunithi nemali
stop.39.blurb: Ithezari yendawo, obala — okungene, okuhambile, nokuthi kungani.
stop.39.title: Izimali zomphakathi
stop.4.blurb: Funda ngokwenza — uhambo ngalunye Luhamba emkhambweni wangempela; ukuqeda okukodwa kuya kuphrofayili yakho.
stop.4.title: Uhambo
stop.40.blurb: Ama-akhawunti ahlanganyelwe ahamba kuphela lapho abantu abahlanganyela kuwo bavumelana.
stop.40.title: Ama-ledger ahlanganyelwe
stop.41.blurb: Uma kuphuzile isibalo sabasebenzi, abasebenzi bekhetha izihlalo ebhodi — ngokubala okufanayo nokulungile.
stop.41.title: Izihlalo zabasebenzi ebhodi
stop.42.blurb: Indlela inhlangano ishintsha ngayo abanikazi noma ishintshe uhlobo — zonke izinyathelo zisemlandweni.
stop.42.title: Ukushintsha kokuba ngumnikazi
stop.43.blurb: Shintsha lapho uhlala khona futhi amalungelo akho akulandela — ukuhlala kuyisikhiye kuphela.
stop.43.title: Yithuthela endaweni entsha
stop.44.blurb: Kungani izikhathi zomthetho nezobulungiswa zihamba ndawonye — iminyaka eyishumi, ihambisana.
stop.44.title: Izikhathi ziphela ndawonye
stop.45.blurb: Bangaki ababehambisana — isilinganiso esikala, hhayi ithuluzi elibusa.
stop.45.title: Ukufika
stop.46.blurb: Konke okufayile kanye nalapho kuya khona — iphutha, umbuzo, noma isicelo sokubuyekezwa.
stop.46.title: Imibiko yakho
stop.47.blurb: Okwakhiwe, okusaseza kufika, nokuthi usitshela kanjani lapho kuswelela khona.
stop.47.title: Ukufikeleleka
stop.48.blurb: Izinqumo zokuklama abantu ababuza kakhulu ngazo, ziphendulwe ngokusebenzisa i-Template.
stop.48.title: Imibuzo enzima
stop.49.blurb: Buyekeza impilo yale node futhi uvule izilawulo zokuhost-a.
stop.49.title: Ukuphathwa kwe-host
stop.5.blurb: Izincazelo zolimi olulula zendlela lokhu kusebenza ngayo. Ukufunda akubizi lutho futhi akuvuli lutho — ukwazi akusona isifakazi.
stop.5.title: Funda
stop.50.blurb: Indlela i-node efikelwa ngayo kunethebhukhu, nokuthi izibonisa kanjani ukuthi iyona ngempela.
stop.50.title: DNS nezitifiketi
stop.51.blurb: Ukukhipha okuvumelekile kuphela — izinto ezine ezincane, hhayi imibono.
stop.51.title: Ukulawula nomthetho osezingeni eliphansi
stop.52.blurb: Abantu abathembekile ngomshini — umbuzo ohlukile kokuthi ubani ophethe isikhundla, futhi awuniki amandla.
stop.52.title: Ubani oqhuba le node
stop.53.blurb: Iziphathiso ziphi ezinye le node ehlangane nazo, nokuthi yini eyamukela kuzo.
stop.53.title: I-mesh
stop.54.blurb: Indlela le node ezibonisa ngayo ukuthi iyona, nokuthi iyibona kanjani amaqhawe ayo.
stop.54.title: Ubunjalo nezikhiye
stop.55.blurb: I-code eyisetshenziswa le node — umhlaba owodwa ungaba nezinguqulo ezahlukene, ngakho kufanele kube gcacile.
stop.55.title: Izinguqulo nokuthuthukiswa
stop.56.blurb: Ama-backup, imilando nemisebenzi egcina izikhathi zihamba.
stop.56.title: Imisebenzi yansuku zonke
stop.57.blurb: I-Peering, Full Faith & Credit, nokuthi isiphatiso siphi esigunyazisayo ngokwezinto.
stop.57.title: I-console yomfelandawonye
stop.58.blurb: Ikomiti lihlangana obala — noma ubani angabuka, abahlali banganikeza ubufakazi, futhi konke okushiwo kubhalwa irekhodi lomphakathi. Usihlalo uhola ekamelweni; uhlelo luhola ubuntuphathi.
stop.58.title: Ukulalelwa kwekomiti okuqondile
stop.6.blurb: Ukuhlala endaweni kuyisidingo kuphela sazo zonke izilungelo lapha.
stop.6.title: Sho lapho uhlala khona
stop.7.blurb: Yonke indawo emhlabeni, kusukela emhlabeni kuya emakhelwaneni — ngayinye izibusa yona.
stop.7.title: Izindawo
stop.8.blurb: Yonke inkamisa, isizwana ngokwesibalo sabantu — izihlalo zilandela abantu.
stop.8.title: Izishayamthetho
stop.9.blurb: Inkulumo evulekile irekhodi lomphakathi — akekho ongayisusa ngasese.
stop.9.title: Isikwebe somphakathi
